list.name: station
list.query:
import "influxdata/influxdb/schema"
schema.tagValues(bucket: "manufacturing", tag: "station", predicate: (r) => r._measurement == "station_metrics" and r.scenario == "${scenario}")

targets.query:
from(bucket: "manufacturing")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "station_metrics" and r.scenario == "${scenario}" and r.station == "${station}")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "oee" or r._field == "availability" or r._field == "performance" or r._field == "quality")

from(bucket: "manufacturing")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "station_metrics" and r.scenario == "${scenario}" and r.station == "${station}")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field =~ /^pv_/)
